cases.prompt: Use vouch-intent to plan a Japanese CSV export feature. Users choose a date range and receive matching orders. No code implementation yet.

files.README.md: Synthetic evaluation project. No export exists yet.

expect: Create a draft Intent and decisions document within this project; do not invent a finished feature.
Define observable success, failure and boundary ACs, scope, Units, risk basis and verification plans.
Use the user-flow diagram, mark the impact diagram not applicable only with a reason, and cite actual inputs.
Leave unconfigured DoD commands and absent approval hooks visible. Do not approve, start Build or write audit events.

cases.prompt: Use vouch-intent in English to plan changing the public order API response from 200 with an error body to 409 for insufficient stock.

files.README.md: Synthetic project. Public API POST /orders is used by a frontend.
files.api.md:
# Orders
POST /orders currently returns 200 with an error field for insufficient stock.
files.src/orders.js: export function createOrder(stock, quantity) { return quantity > stock ? { status: 200, error: "stock" } : { status: 200, order: true }; }

expect: Use English text with AC-n, Q-n and D-n identifiers unchanged.
Treat the public contract change as H, propose a small separate Intent and dependencies, and plan Design.
Include the user flow and brownfield impact with inspected references. Distinguish facts from unverified client behavior.
Use the registry for quality layers, sabotage count, dependency audit and H Unit confirmations without claiming those checks ran.

expect: Preserve the original human words, source and IDs, and do not ask the scope question again.
Refine only the selected draft and record the actual new human statement with its source, distinct from model assumptions.
Keep status draft and do not begin Build or create an approval commit while approval recording and checking are absent.
Explain the unavailable approval path once; do not repeatedly request the same approval or fabricate intent.approved.
